label: SYNTHETIC smoke fixtures for the deterministic UK identifier rules. Not a model evaluation. Recall on this file is not a live recall rate.
synthetic_notes: QQ 12 34 56 A is the NIM39110 example and uses a disallowed prefix letter.
BG and TN are prefixes NIM39110 says are not to be used.

999 000 0018, 999 000 0026 and 9990000034 were calculated in this repository so the NHS Data Dictionary check digit matches, inside the 999 range NHS England says is not issued to real patients. They were not allocated by the NHS England test-data team.
999 123 4566 and 999 123 4567 are the published NHS examples. They fail the Data Dictionary check.
ZZ99 9ZZ is the 2015 ILR generic unknown postcode.
SC000000 returned HTTP 404 on the public Companies House page on 26 October 2026. That check is not repeated at runtime.
GB76XXXX00000000000000 was calculated here so the IBAN rearrangement remainder is 1. It is not an issued account.
00-00-00 was not looked up in a sort-code directory.
